    • update

    • update

      double update(Point2D.Double location, double energy, double heading, double velocity, long time, boolean bumped)
      Takes a scan. Returns the power of the shot the energy drop since the last scan shows, or NaN: a drop in [0.1, 3.0] that neither our bullets nor a bump (bumped: a wall or a robot stopped it) explain (MSENSE-2). A drop above 3.0 is damage from another robot, unless the scans were far enough apart for several shots to fit, when it is recorded as neither. A hit from another robot's weak bullet can look the same; such false shots are cheap, and accepted.
